# Third-party sources and distribution

This OS inherits the reviewed RK3326 legacy boot chain from Gizlet commit `8f51ad8cafcc576fd8a789e3b8e75fb35467b046` and the earlier GizOS board work. The Rockchip Bazel rules in [`tools/bazel/rockchip`](../tools/bazel/rockchip) are derived from GizOS commit `0ac3bfdc2bafa78bfc89965931b5ce22faeff795`, the merge of [GizOS PR #895](https://github.com/GizClaw/gizos/pull/895), and are maintained here without a Bazel dependency on GizOS. Each upstream has one manifest here with its URLs and SHA-256 digests. The R36S board package selects from them. [Modules](../MODULE.bazel) · [R36S selection](../boards/gameconsole/r36s/rk3326/BUILD.bazel) · [Reviewed board code](https://github.com/gizlet/gizlet/tree/8f51ad8cafcc576fd8a789e3b8e75fb35467b046) · [GizOS origin](https://github.com/GizClaw/gizos/tree/0ac3bfdc2bafa78bfc89965931b5ce22faeff795/tools/bazel/native/rockchip)

| Input | Fixed source and installed notice |
| --- | --- |
| Linux 7.1.2 | Kernel.org archive, the version ROCKNIX builds for RK3326. [Manifest](linux/repositories.bzl) The card carries `COPYING`, the GPL-2.0 text and Linux syscall exception in `/usr/share/licenses/linux/`. Source files retain their individual notices. |
| Board patches | The Gizlet ROCKNIX fork at `21d9dc6759cc3016c2e2e7244574c0e6a5a6bcd8` on its `next` branch, which follows upstream ROCKNIX. The board applies ROCKNIX's RK3326 kernel patch set for Linux 7.1.2 in ROCKNIX's order, builds ROCKNIX's generic DSI panel driver in, and uses ROCKNIX's R36S device trees. Files keep their fork paths in `@rocknix`. [Manifest](rocknix/repositories.bzl) |
| Joypad driver | `rocknix-singleadc-joypad` from `ROCKNIX/rocknix-joypad` at the revision that fork commit uses, built into the kernel. [Manifest](rocknix-joypad/repositories.bzl) |
| U-Boot 2017.09 | Hardkernel source `2492a3e467e332e2350d987234ce6123700b3392`, with build fix and defconfig from the same fork commit, plus the board's trust packer patch. [Manifest](u-boot/repositories.bzl) General licensing information is in `/usr/share/licenses/u-boot/`. |
| Rockchip rkbin | DDR 333 MHz v2.11, miniloader v1.40 and BL31 v1.34 downloaded from `rockchip-linux/rkbin` at `74213af1e952c4683d2e35952507133b61394862`, with the original license in `/usr/share/licenses/rockchip-rkbin`. [Manifest](rkbin/repositories.bzl) |
| BusyBox 1.37.0 | Original BusyBox archive and the board's complete config. The card includes `/usr/share/licenses/BusyBox`. [Manifest](busybox/repositories.bzl) The static build uses the build VM's Debian bookworm AArch64 glibc, whose LGPL text is in `/usr/share/licenses/glibc-LGPL-2.1`. |
| Dropbear 2026.94 | Original Dropbear archive, built statically like BusyBox for ssh over WiFi (`dropbear`, `dropbearkey`, `scp`). The card includes `/usr/share/licenses/dropbear`. [Manifest](dropbear/repositories.bzl) [Options](../boot/dropbear/localoptions.h) |
| wpa_supplicant 2.12, libnl 3.12.0 | Original hostap and libnl archives. wpa_supplicant is linked statically with libnl and the build VM's Debian OpenSSL, like BusyBox. The card includes `/usr/share/licenses/wpa_supplicant` (BSD) and `/usr/share/licenses/libnl` (LGPL-2.1). [hostap](hostap/repositories.bzl) [libnl](libnl/repositories.bzl) [Build](../boot/wpa_supplicant/build.sh) |
| linux-firmware 20261019 | `rtlwifi/rtl8188fufw.bin`, built into the kernel with `CONFIG_EXTRA_FIRMWARE`. Redistributable under `LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt`, included on the card. [Manifest](linux-firmware/repositories.bzl) |
| Booter | This repository's Booter is built statically with the build VM's Debian GCC and glibc, like BusyBox, and is covered by the same glibc LGPL notice. |
| Build VM | Debian bookworm arm64 packages from `snapshot.debian.org`, pinned in a lock file, and libkrun 2.0 from its `main` branch. Nothing from the VM is installed on the card except the statically linked glibc. [Package lock](../tools/bazel/debian/packages.lock.json) · [libkrun manifest](../tools/bazel/krun/repositories.bzl) |

The board DTS retains its SPDX identifier. The complete 4 MiB BL31 trust output must match the checked-in reference digest. [Kernel patch set in fork](https://github.com/gizlet/rocknix/tree/21d9dc6759cc3016c2e2e7244574c0e6a5a6bcd8/projects/ROCKNIX/devices/RK3326/patches/linux) · [U-Boot selection in fork](https://github.com/gizlet/rocknix/tree/21d9dc6759cc3016c2e2e7244574c0e6a5a6bcd8/projects/ROCKNIX/devices/RK3326/packages/u-boot-legacy) · [rkbin source](https://github.com/rockchip-linux/rkbin/tree/74213af1e952c4683d2e35952507133b61394862) · [trust SHA-256](../boards/gameconsole/r36s/rk3326/trust.sha256)

## Corresponding source

When distributing images, provide the matching Linux, U-Boot, BusyBox, Dropbear, wpa_supplicant and libnl source archives, their licenses, all applied board and build patches, defconfigs, DTS files and the scripts and configuration used to build and install the binaries. Include this OS revision, which contains the build rules. The compiler, C library and OpenSSL are the locked Debian `gcc-12`, `libc6-dev` and `libssl-dev` packages; provide their sources from the same snapshot, with the corresponding library materials and relinking support required for those static binaries. Preserve Rockchip's license with its firmware. Keep the source package, version manifest and hashes available to image recipients through the release's source delivery mechanism.
